lines: In the twenty eleven, twelve season, Cristiano Ronaldo scored sixty goals.
He scored against every single team in La Liga. All nineteen of them.
Real Madrid won the league with a hundred points, and Ronaldo scored the winner at the Camp Now.
That's a Ballon Dor season. Easy.
Except, five hundred kilometres away, someone was having a very different kind of year.
Wait. How many did Messi score?
Seventy-three? That's not a season. That's a video game.
Sixty goals. And Ronaldo still finished second.
